name: Sparkplug B — SCADA Host Commands the Device
description: A Sparkplug host writes the metric Speaker/Play via NCMD and the device reacts: it plays an audio clip, records the command in a variable, and acknowledges by publishing the result back as Sparkplug telemetry. Demonstrates bidirectional Sparkplug B integration. Requires Sparkplug B enabled in Settings with a Camera/LastCommand metric declared.
